title: Shmuel bar Bidri
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He reported in the name of Rav, [Menachot 35b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.35b.10). Dikdukei Soferim has bar Madrakhi; the Rosh reads bar Mari.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rav Shmuel bar Bidri speaking in the name of Rav. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3382&lang=en) cites this transmission and the other attributions in the same paragraph. Madrakhi and Mari remain the readings Hyman reports from Dikdukei Soferim and the Rosh.
